'''Saqqar''' was an [[Water/Legends|icy]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was located within the [[Saqqar system/Legends|Saqqar system]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] controlled by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The planet lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] called [[the Dead Road]], which connected it to the worlds of [[Tisht]] and [[Usk (planet)|Usk]]. A smaller hyperlane linked the planet to the world of [[Nar Haaska/Legends|Nar Haaska]].<ref name="TEA" />

The surface of Saqqar was covered in snowy plains, where colossal ruined towers were visible that were left behind by an [[Unidentified Saqqar civilization|extinct civilization]]. Saqqar was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by a half-derelict [[Unidentified orbital station|orbital station]] that served the needs of the occasional [[Starship/Legends|starship]] traveling along The Dead Road.<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Kajidier]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]], a Hutt clan, had influence on Saqqar.<ref name="LoNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|And then there were names I thought sounded strange and vaguely foreboding, such as Saqqar and Usk.|Jason Fry|<ref name="Suvudu">{{Suvudu|url=2009/08/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-mapping-hutt-space.html|text=STAR WARS: THE ESSENTIAL ATLAS &ndash; Mapping Hutt Space}}</ref>}}
Saqqar was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the planet in grid square T-11.<ref name="TEA" /> In a 2009 article published on [[Unbound Worlds|Suvudu.com]], Fry noted that the name of Saqqar sounded unusual and somewhat foreboding to him.<ref name="Suvudu" />
